learning_outcomes.text: create programmable solutions to problems with an imperative approach
create abstraction using subroutines and simple composite data types
use abstraction and interfaces when collaborating in the construction of a mini-project

syllabus_topics: Using the computer system and computer science - Introduction to the window system which are used, Linux, the editor Emacs. Introduction in handling workstations.
Programming - Introduction to programming and discussions about different programming languages. Handling of system software like compilers and linkers.

Specific in Ada: the language elements, types, declarations, expressions, statements, subprograms, I/O, how to structure programs. Packages. Data structures like arrays, records, files, pointers. A small programming project.
assessment_rules: The grading scale is a four-grade scale (U, 3, 4, 5).
bibliography: Jonsson, Torbjörn, Programmering i Ada 95 för nybörjare och erfarna Lund: Studentlitteratur ISBN: 9144039891
